episode.subject: round-leaved sundew
episode.title: Too close together
episode.body: My first fly this spring pulled two of my leaves together trying to get free. Now they're stuck to each other, and every time he struggles I tug on myself.

proposals.fictionBoundary: Curled leaves, adhesive tentacles and insect among them are visible. Fly pulling leaves together, leaves adhering to each other, ongoing movement, first spring capture and bodily sensation are fictional, not recorded by observer or established by a single still. No insect species/sex is identified; he is fictional. No snapping trap, instantaneous voluntary curling, digestive endpoint or eaten shell claimed.
